text:
- yad etad bahudhā proktam āṇavaṃ śivatāptaye — this āṇava, taught manifoldly, aims at Śiva-hood: the lowest rung is already teleologically complete. [tal-a34-v01] (R) [CLM-001]
- tatrāntar antarāviśya — entering into the intervals therein: the practice is penetration between (antar-antara) the manifold forms, not piling more on. [tal-a34-v01] (R) [CLM-002]
- viśrāmyet savidhe pade — rest in the proximate station: the optative commands settling, and savidha carries both nearness and kindredness — the resting place is already of the goal's kind. [tal-a34-v01] (R) [CLM-003]
- The āṇava rung: multiply taught, it works by entering the gaps between its own forms and resting in the near-kindred station — ascent by deepening, not by adding. [tal-a34-v01] (R) [CLM-004]
- tato 'py āṇava-saṃtyāgāt śāktīṃ bhūmim upāśrayet — by abandoning even the āṇava: each rung is climbed by leaving it (api concedes even this lowest hold). [tal-a34-v02] (R) [CLM-005]
- tato 'pi śāmbhavīm evam — then likewise the Śāmbhava: the same abandon-and-resort motion repeats upward. [tal-a34-v02] (R) [CLM-006]
- tāratamya-kramāt sphuṭam — in graded sequence, distinctly: the rungs stay distinct (sphuṭam), no blurring of means. [tal-a34-v02] (R) [CLM-007]
- The ladder law: resort by abandonment, rung by rung, each distinct — the mechanism that makes the final means-lessness (v3) a completion rather than a refusal. [tal-a34-v02] (R) [CLM-008]
- kramodita-vibodha-mahāmarīci-saṃpūrita-prasara-bhairava-bhāva-bhāgī — partaking of the Bhairava-state whose expanse is filled with the great rays of sequentially-arisen awakening: the climbed ladder's fruit in one compound. [tal-a34-v03] (R) [CLM-009]
- ante 'bhyupāya-nirapekṣatayā eva — in the end with utter independence from means: the anupāya moment (Tantrasara 1 caturvidham; TAL ch2 gatopāya). [tal-a34-v03] (R) [CLM-010]
- nityaṃ svātmānam āviśati garbhitaviśvarūpam — enters forever one's own self, universe-wombed: the self entered already contains the all. [tal-a34-v03] (R) [CLM-011]
- The crown: ladder-ripened awakening fills the Bhairava expanse, means fall away, and entry into one's own self is entry into the all-containing — liberation as recognition, not acquisition. [tal-a34-v03] (R) [CLM-012]
